text: 三杯两盏淡酒，怎敌他、晚来风急
pinyin: sān bēi liǎng zhǎn dàn jiǔ, zěn dí tā, wǎn lái fēng jí
literal: three · cups · two · small cups · weak · wine, how · withstand · it · evening · come · wind · fierce
natural: a few cups of thin wine, how can they hold off the fierce wind at dawn?

meaning.en: A few cups of weak wine are no match for the sharp evening wind; the widowed poet cannot drink away her cold and her grief.
meaning.zh: 几杯淡酒，怎能抵挡傍晚急风的寒意？比喻借酒浇愁，终究挡不住内心的凄凉。

examples.zh: 她轻声念着“三杯两盏淡酒，怎敌他、晚来风急”，眼眶红了。
examples.en: She murmured 'A few cups of thin wine, how can they hold off the fierce wind at dawn?', her eyes reddening.

examples.zh: 借酒浇愁愁更愁，真是“三杯两盏淡酒，怎敌他、晚来风急”。
examples.en: Drinking to drown sorrow only deepens it: 'a few cups of thin wine can never hold off the dawn wind'.

story.en: Li Qingzhao (1084-c.1155) wrote this ci after the fall of the Northern Song and the death of her husband Zhao Mingcheng, in exile in the south; its opening lines pile up doubled words of loneliness before this couplet on wine and wind.
story.zh: 李清照（1084—约1155）在北宋覆亡、丈夫赵明诚去世后流寓南方，写下这首词；开头连用叠字写尽孤寂，随后是这句写酒与风。

usage.en: Quoted when a little comfort cannot ease a deep sorrow. Textbooks print 晚来风急; some editions read 晓来风急. Part of the opening of 《声声慢》, which begins 寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清。
usage.zh: 常用来说明一点慰藉难解深愁。课本作“晚来风急”，也有版本作“晓来风急”。属《声声慢》开篇，该词以“寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清”起句。

variants: 三杯两盏淡酒，怎敌他、晓来风急

text: 梧桐更兼细雨，到黄昏、点点滴滴
pinyin: wú tóng gèng jiān xì yǔ, dào huáng hūn, diǎn diǎn dī dī
literal: plane tree · moreover · plus · fine · rain, until · dusk, drop · drop · drip · drip
natural: the plane trees, and fine rain besides, dripping on and on until dusk

meaning.en: Fine rain falls on the plane-tree leaves and keeps dripping until dusk, each drop a fresh pang of loneliness.
meaning.zh: 细雨打在梧桐叶上，一直滴到黄昏，每一滴都添一分愁绪。

examples.zh: 窗外梧桐细雨，他想起“梧桐更兼细雨，到黄昏、点点滴滴”。
examples.en: Outside the window, plane trees stood in fine rain, and he recalled 'the plane trees, and fine rain besides, dripping on until dusk'.

examples.zh: 语文课上我们背了“梧桐更兼细雨，到黄昏、点点滴滴”。
examples.en: In Chinese class we memorised 'plane trees and fine rain, dripping on and on until dusk'.

story.en: The couplet comes late in Li Qingzhao's 《声声慢》; the sound of rain on the broad leaves of the plane tree outside the window drives home the poet's solitude before the closing line 'how could one word, sorrow, say it all?'.
story.zh: 此联出自李清照《声声慢》后半，窗外雨打梧桐之声更添孤寂，直引出结句“怎一个愁字了得”。

usage.en: Quoted to set a mood of rainy-evening sorrow. It is the second-to-last couplet of 《声声慢》, before the closing 这次第，怎一个愁字了得.
usage.zh: 用来渲染雨夜黄昏的愁绪。是《声声慢》结尾前的一联，其后是“这次第，怎一个愁字了得”。

text: 满地黄花堆积，憔悴损，如今有谁堪摘
pinyin: mǎn dì huáng huā duī jī, qiáo cuì sǔn, rú jīn yǒu shéi kān zhāi
literal: full · ground · yellow · flowers · piled up, wasted · withered, now · have · who · fit · pick
natural: yellow chrysanthemums heaped over the ground, faded and spent; who is there now to pick them?

meaning.en: Fallen yellow chrysanthemums lie in heaps, withered; there is no one left now who would pick them, a picture of the poet's own faded, lonely self.
meaning.zh: 黄菊落满一地，已经憔悴凋残，如今还有谁来采摘？借残菊写自己的衰残孤独。

equivalents: nobody left to pick the flowers

examples.zh: 她在秋日的菊园前念道：“满地黄花堆积，憔悴损，如今有谁堪摘。”
examples.en: Before the autumn chrysanthemums she recited, 'Yellow flowers heaped on the ground, faded, who is there now to pick them?'

examples.zh: 读到“满地黄花堆积，憔悴损，如今有谁堪摘”，我想起李清照的晚年。
examples.en: Reading 'yellow flowers heaped on the ground, faded and spent, who is there now to pick them', I thought of Li Qingzhao's last years.

story.en: In this ci Li Qingzhao sees chrysanthemums fallen in autumn and sees herself in them, aged, alone and with no one to share the flowers, as she once had with her husband.
story.zh: 李清照在秋日见满地菊花凋落，联想到自己晚景凄凉，再无人与她共赏，不复当年与丈夫同赏之乐。

usage.en: Quoted for withered flowers and for loneliness and ageing. 黄花 means chrysanthemums here.
usage.zh: 用来写残花凋零，也喻孤独衰老。这里的“黄花”指菊花。

text: 僵卧孤村不自哀，尚思为国戍轮台
pinyin: jiāng wò gū cūn bù zì āi, shàng sī wèi guó shù lún tái
literal: stiff · lying · lonely · village · not · self · pity, still · think · for · country · guard · Luntai
natural: lying stiff in a lonely village, I do not pity myself; I still think of guarding Luntai for my country

meaning.en: Old, ill and bedridden in a remote village, the poet does not pity himself but still dreams of defending the frontier for his country.
meaning.zh: 年老多病，僵卧在偏僻的村子里，却不为自己哀叹，仍想着为国守卫边疆。

examples.zh: 他年过八旬仍关心国事，常吟“僵卧孤村不自哀，尚思为国戍轮台”。
examples.en: Past eighty and still concerned for the nation, he often chanted 'lying stiff in a lonely village, I do not pity myself, still thinking of guarding Luntai for my country'.

examples.zh: 住院期间，他读着“僵卧孤村不自哀，尚思为国戍轮台”，心里踏实了许多。
examples.en: In hospital, reading 'lying stiff in a lonely village, I do not pity myself', he felt much steadier.

origin.source: 陆游《十一月四日风雨大作》

story.en: Lu You (1125-1210) wrote this in old age, in retirement at his home village of Shanyin; as wind and rain beat on the window, he dreamed that night of riding an iron horse across frozen rivers to the front, the second poem in the pair.
story.zh: 陆游（1125—1210）晚年闲居山阴老家，风雨交加之夜写下此诗，当夜梦见铁马冰河、奔赴前线，即这组诗的第二首。

usage.en: Quoted to praise patriotism and resolve that old age and illness cannot dampen. 轮台 is a frontier garrison in the northwest, standing for border defence.
usage.zh: 用来赞颂不因老病而消沉的爱国志气。“轮台”是西北边塞，代指戍守边疆。

text: 伤心桥下春波绿，曾是惊鸿照影来
pinyin: shāng xīn qiáo xià chūn bō lǜ, céng shì jīng hóng zhào yǐng lái
literal: heart-breaking · bridge · beneath · spring · waves · green, once · was · startled · swan · cast · reflection · come
natural: beneath the heartbreak bridge the spring water is green; here once came a graceful swan to see her reflection

meaning.en: The spring water under the bridge is as green as ever, but it is the same water that once mirrored the graceful figure of his lost love.
meaning.zh: 桥下春水依旧碧绿，当年却曾映照过她轻盈的身影，今昔对比，令人伤心。

equivalents: same place, but she is gone

examples.zh: 重回故地，他望着桥下碧水，默念“伤心桥下春波绿，曾是惊鸿照影来”。
examples.en: Back at the old place, he gazed at the green water and whispered 'beneath the heartbreak bridge the spring waves are green; here she once came, graceful as a swan, to see her reflection'.

examples.zh: 这座桥让我想起“伤心桥下春波绿，曾是惊鸿照影来”的名句。
examples.en: This bridge reminds me of the famous line 'beneath the heartbreak bridge the spring waves are green; here once came her image, light as a swan'.

story.en: Lu You was forced to divorce his first wife Tang Wan; years later he met her by chance in Shen Garden in Shaoxing and wrote a poem on the wall. Returning in old age, he wrote the two 《沈园》 poems, of which this is a famous couplet.
story.zh: 陆游与前妻唐琬被迫分离，多年后两人在绍兴沈园偶遇，他题词于壁。晚年重游，作《沈园》二首，此为其中名句。

usage.en: Quoted for grief at a place tied to a lost love. Note 曾是, not 疑是, in the standard text. 惊鸿 (a startled swan) describes a woman's light, graceful figure; compare the existing 惊鸿一瞥.
usage.zh: 用来写睹物思人的伤感。通行本作“曾是”而非“疑是”。“惊鸿”形容女子身影轻盈，可参看“惊鸿一瞥”。

text: 离愁渐远渐无穷，迢迢不断如春水
pinyin: lí chóu jiàn yuǎn jiàn wú qióng, tiáo tiáo bù duàn rú chūn shuǐ
literal: parting · sorrow · gradually · far · gradually · no · end, far-stretching · unbroken · like · spring · water
natural: parting sorrow grows endless the farther I go, stretching unbroken like spring water

meaning.en: The farther the traveller goes, the more his sorrow at parting grows, flowing on without a break like a spring stream.
meaning.zh: 越走越远，离别的愁绪也越来越深，像春水一样绵延不断。

equivalents: sorrow that flows like a river

examples.zh: 火车渐行渐远，他心里“离愁渐远渐无穷，迢迢不断如春水”。
examples.en: As the train pulled away, 'his parting sorrow grew endless the farther he went, like spring water flowing on'.

examples.zh: 她在信里引了“离愁渐远渐无穷，迢迢不断如春水”。
examples.en: In her letter she quoted 'parting sorrow grows endless the farther I go, unbroken like spring water'.

story.en: Ouyang Xiu (1007-1072) wrote this ci, beginning 候馆梅残, from the viewpoint of a traveller leaving home in spring; the sorrow of parting is likened to a stream that keeps flowing.
story.zh: 欧阳修（1007—1072）这首以“候馆梅残”开头的词，写春日离家的游子，以不断的春水比喻无尽离愁。

usage.en: Quoted for parting sorrow that deepens with distance. It follows 草薰风暖摇征辔 in the first half of 《踏莎行》.
usage.zh: 用来写离别后越远越深的愁思。出自《踏莎行》上阕，前接“草薰风暖摇征辔”。

text: 碧云天，黄叶地，秋色连波，波上寒烟翠
pinyin: bì yún tiān, huáng yè dì, qiū sè lián bō, bō shàng hán yān cuì
literal: azure · clouds · sky, yellow · leaves · ground, autumn · colour · joins · waves, waves · above · cold · mist · green
natural: blue clouds in the sky, yellow leaves on the ground; autumn colour runs into the waves, and green mist lies cold on the water

meaning.en: A wide autumn scene: clouds in the sky, fallen yellow leaves on the ground, and the colour of autumn merging with the river and its cold green mist.
meaning.zh: 描绘一幅开阔的秋景：天上碧云，地上黄叶，秋色与江水相连，水面泛着青翠寒烟。

examples.zh: 秋游时，她望着远处的湖光，念起“碧云天，黄叶地，秋色连波，波上寒烟翠”。
examples.en: On the autumn outing she gazed at the lake and recited 'blue clouds in the sky, yellow leaves on the ground, autumn colour joined to the waves'.

examples.zh: 作文里引用“碧云天，黄叶地，秋色连波，波上寒烟翠”来描写秋景，很有画面感。
examples.en: Quoting 'blue clouds, yellow leaves, autumn colour joined to the waves' in the essay made the autumn scene vivid.

story.en: Fan Zhongyan (989-1052) painted this broad autumn scene as the opening of his nostalgic ci, before turning to the homesickness of a traveller far from home.
story.zh: 范仲淹（989—1052）以这幅壮阔的秋景开篇，随后转写游子的思乡之情。

usage.en: Quoted to describe autumn scenery and as a set piece in essays. It is the opening of 《苏幕遮·怀旧》, which turns to homesickness (黯乡魂，追旅思).
usage.zh: 用来描写秋景，也是作文常用的名句。是《苏幕遮·怀旧》开篇，下文转写乡愁（黯乡魂，追旅思）。

text: 塞下秋来风景异，衡阳雁去无留意
pinyin: sài xià qiū lái fēng jǐng yì, héng yáng yàn qù wú liú yì
literal: frontier · beneath · autumn · comes · scenery · different, Hengyang · wild geese · go · no · lingering · intent
natural: autumn comes to the frontier and the scenery is strange; the geese leave for Hengyang with no wish to linger

meaning.en: Autumn at the border looks nothing like autumn at home, and even the wild geese fly south to Hengyang without a backward glance.
meaning.zh: 边塞的秋天景象与内地迥异，连大雁也毫无留恋地飞往衡阳。

examples.zh: 读到“塞下秋来风景异，衡阳雁去无留意”，仿佛看见了边塞的萧瑟。
examples.en: Reading 'autumn comes to the frontier and the scenery is strange; the geese leave for Hengyang with no wish to linger', one almost sees the bleak border.

examples.zh: 老师用“塞下秋来风景异，衡阳雁去无留意”讲解边塞词的特点。
examples.en: The teacher used 'at the frontier autumn looks strange, and the geese leave Hengyang-bound without a thought' to explain frontier ci.

story.en: Fan Zhongyan guarded the northwest frontier against the Western Xia in the 1040s; this ci, usually called the first Song frontier-style ci, was written there.
story.zh: 范仲淹于1040年代镇守西北边防、抵御西夏，在军中写下此词，常被视为宋代边塞词的开创之作。

usage.en: Quoted for the harshness of frontier autumn. 衡阳 had a Wild Goose Peak (回雁峰), where, by tradition, geese turn back in autumn.
usage.zh: 用来写边塞秋景的荒寒。衡阳有回雁峰，相传大雁南飞至此止步。

text: 羌管悠悠霜满地，人不寐，将军白发征夫泪
pinyin: qiāng guǎn yōu yōu shuāng mǎn dì, rén bù mèi, jiāng jūn bái fà zhēng fū lèi
literal: Qiang · pipe · long-drawn · frost · covers · ground, people · not · sleep, general · white · hair · soldier · tears
natural: the Qiang pipe sounds long and frost covers the ground; none can sleep, the general turns white-haired, the soldiers weep

meaning.en: To the mournful sound of a flute on a frosty night, nobody sleeps: the general's hair has turned white and the soldiers weep for home.
meaning.zh: 霜夜里羌笛悠悠，人人无法入睡，将军愁白了头发，征夫流下思乡的泪。

examples.zh: 夜深人静，他想到“羌管悠悠霜满地，人不寐，将军白发征夫泪”，替戍边的战士心酸。
examples.en: Late at night he thought of 'the Qiang pipe sounds long, frost on the ground, none can sleep, the general white-haired, soldiers weeping', and ached for the border guards.

examples.zh: 展览里写着“羌管悠悠霜满地，人不寐，将军白发征夫泪”，配着戍边老兵的照片。
examples.en: The exhibition showed 'Qiang pipe, frost, none sleeping, the general white-haired, soldiers in tears' beside photographs of old border guards.

story.en: The closing of Fan Zhongyan's frontier ci: after lines saying that home is ten thousand li away and no victory yet gained, it ends in this scene of frost, flute, sleeplessness and tears.
story.zh: 范仲淹边塞词的结尾：前文写家远万里、功业未成，最后以霜、笛、不眠与泪收束。

usage.en: Quoted for the hardship and homesickness of soldiers on distant service. Closing lines of 《渔家傲·秋思》, after 浊酒一杯家万里，燕然未勒归无计.
usage.zh: 用来写戍边将士的艰苦与思乡。是《渔家傲·秋思》结尾，前文有“浊酒一杯家万里，燕然未勒归无计”。

text: 便纵有千种风情，更与何人说
pinyin: biàn zòng yǒu qiān zhǒng fēng qíng, gèng yǔ hé rén shuō
literal: even · if · have · thousand · kinds · tender feeling, further · with · what · person · tell
natural: even if I had a thousand tender feelings, to whom could I tell them?

meaning.en: Even with a thousand kinds of tenderness in my heart, there is no one left to tell them to once we are parted.
meaning.zh: 即使心中有千般柔情蜜意，分别之后又能向谁倾诉呢？

examples.zh: 异地多年，他常想“便纵有千种风情，更与何人说”。
examples.en: Years apart, he often thought, 'even with a thousand tender feelings, whom could I tell them to?'

examples.zh: 她抄下“便纵有千种风情，更与何人说”，寄给远方的人。
examples.en: She copied out 'even with a thousand tender feelings, to whom could I tell them?' and sent it to someone far away.

story.en: The closing of Liu Yong's (c.984-c.1053) best-known ci, a farewell to a lover at a riverside, which begins 寒蝉凄切, with 'tears in our eyes and no words'.
story.zh: 柳永（约984—约1053）最著名的词之一，写与情人江边话别，开篇“寒蝉凄切”，“执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎”，此为结句。

usage.en: Quoted for lovers parted and feelings with nowhere to go. It ends 《雨霖铃》, after 今宵酒醒何处？杨柳岸，晓风残月。
usage.zh: 用来写情侣离别、情无所寄。是《雨霖铃》结句，前文有“今宵酒醒何处？杨柳岸，晓风残月”。

text: 东南形胜，三吴都会，钱塘自古繁华
pinyin: dōng nán xíng shèng, sān wú dū huì, qián táng zì gǔ fán huá
literal: south-east · strategic · splendid, three · Wu · metropolis, Qiantang · from · ancient · prosperous
natural: a splendid stronghold of the south-east, metropolis of the three Wu regions, Qiantang has been prosperous since ancient times

meaning.en: A famous opening praising Hangzhou: a scenic and strategic place in the south-east, a great city of the Wu region, flourishing since ancient times.
meaning.zh: 盛赞杭州的名句：东南的名胜要地，吴地的大都会，钱塘自古繁华。

examples.zh: 旅游宣传片以“东南形胜，三吴都会，钱塘自古繁华”开场。
examples.en: The tourism film opens with 'a splendid south-eastern stronghold, metropolis of the three Wu regions, Qiantang prosperous since ancient times'.

examples.zh: 来杭州之前，我先读了“东南形胜，三吴都会，钱塘自古繁华”。
examples.en: Before coming to Hangzhou I read 'splendid south-eastern stronghold, metropolis of the Wu region, Qiantang long prosperous'.

story.en: Liu Yong wrote this ci to praise Hangzhou and present it to the local official Sun He. A later account says the lines made the Jin ruler long to seize the south, though that story is a legend.
story.zh: 柳永作此词赞美杭州，献给当地长官孙何。后人传说金主读后有投鞭渡江之志，但此说属传闻。

usage.en: Often quoted to praise Hangzhou's long prosperity. 钱塘 is old Hangzhou; 三吴 refers to the Wu region of the lower Yangtze.
usage.zh: 常用来赞美杭州历史悠久、繁华富庶。“钱塘”即旧时杭州，“三吴”指长江下游的吴地。

text: 郴江幸自绕郴山，为谁流下潇湘去
pinyin: chēn jiāng xìng zì rào chēn shān, wèi shéi liú xià xiāo xiāng qù
literal: Chen · river · fortunately · by itself · circles · Chen · mountain, for · whom · flows · down · Xiaoxiang · away
natural: the Chen River was meant to circle Chen Mountain; for whom does it flow on to the Xiao and Xiang?

meaning.en: The river should have stayed circling its own mountain, yet it flows away to the Xiao and Xiang; the poet asks why, comparing himself, banished from home.
meaning.zh: 郴江本应绕着郴山，却流向潇湘而去，诗人借此发问，感叹自己被贬离乡、身不由己。

examples.zh: 读到“郴江幸自绕郴山，为谁流下潇湘去”，他想起了自己的漂泊。
examples.en: Reading 'the Chen River was meant to circle Chen Mountain; for whom does it flow to the Xiang?', he thought of his own wandering.

examples.zh: 苏轼读了“郴江幸自绕郴山，为谁流下潇湘去”，在扇面上抄了又抄。
examples.en: Su Shi, it is said, read 'the Chen River circles the mountain; for whom does it flow down to the Xiang?' and copied it again and again on his fan.

story.en: Qin Guan (1049-1100) wrote this ci while banished to Chenzhou (in today's Hunan) after the fall of his patrons; its last lines ask why the river leaves its mountain, as he has had to leave his.
story.zh: 秦观（1049—1100）因旧党失势被贬至郴州（今湖南），写下此词；结句问江水为何离山而去，如他自己被迫离开故园。

usage.en: Quoted for being driven from home against one's will. 幸自 means 本来就, 'by nature'. Su Shi is said to have loved these lines enough to write them on a fan.
usage.zh: 用来写被迫离乡、身不由己之感。“幸自”意为“本来”。相传苏轼极爱此二句，曾书于扇上。

text: 斜阳外，寒鸦万点，流水绕孤村
pinyin: xié yáng wài, hán yā wàn diǎn, liú shuǐ rào gū cūn
literal: slanting · sun · beyond, cold · crows · ten thousand · dots, flowing · water · circles · lonely · village
natural: beyond the setting sun, a myriad dots of cold crows, and a stream winding round a lonely village

meaning.en: A quiet dusk scene: crows dotting the sky beyond the setting sun and a stream curling around a lonely village.
meaning.zh: 一幅黄昏小景：夕阳之外，乌鸦点点，流水环绕着孤零零的村庄。

examples.zh: 他把画题成“斜阳外，寒鸦万点，流水绕孤村”。
examples.en: He titled the painting 'beyond the setting sun, crows in their thousands, and a stream round a lonely village'.

examples.zh: 站在山上望下去，真是“斜阳外，寒鸦万点，流水绕孤村”。
examples.en: Looking down from the hill, it was just 'beyond the setting sun, a myriad crows, and a stream round a lonely village'.

story.en: This couplet appears in Qin Guan's 《满庭芳》 beginning 山抹微云, a farewell ci that made his name. The image echoes lines traditionally ascribed to Emperor Yang of Sui.
story.zh: 此联出自秦观以“山抹微云”开篇的《满庭芳》，这首送别词使他名声大振，画面化自相传为隋炀帝的诗句。

usage.en: Used to describe quiet, bleak evening scenery. Qin Guan borrowed it from a poem often ascribed to Emperor Yang of Sui, 寒鸦千万点，流水绕孤村, and improved it.
usage.zh: 用来描绘静寂荒寒的黄昏景色。秦观化用相传为隋炀帝所作的“寒鸦千万点，流水绕孤村”而更为凝练。

text: 小园香径独徘徊
pinyin: xiǎo yuán xiāng jìng dú pái huái
literal: small · garden · fragrant · path · alone · pace
natural: alone, I wander the scented paths of the little garden

meaning.en: Alone in a small garden among fallen petals, the poet paces up and down, lost in thought about time and loss.
meaning.zh: 独自在落花飘香的小园小径上来回徘徊，感慨时光流逝、旧事难追。

examples.zh: 黄昏时她在院里独自走着，口中念着“小园香径独徘徊”。
examples.en: At dusk she walked alone in the yard, murmuring 'alone I wander the scented paths of the little garden'.

examples.zh: 散文的结尾，作者以“小园香径独徘徊”收笔，余味悠长。
examples.en: The essay ends on 'alone I wander the scented garden paths', leaving a lingering aftertaste.

story.en: Yan Shu (991-1055), a prime minister and a master of the gentle ci, closed this poem on the passing of spring and time with a lone figure walking in a garden.
story.zh: 晏殊（991—1055）官至宰相，擅写温婉小词；这首词写春去时光流逝，以一人在园中独步作结。

date.en: Northern Song, first half of 11th c.

usage.en: Quoted for solitary, wistful strolls. It is the last line of 《浣溪沙》 (一曲新词酒一杯), and follows the famous couplet 无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来, which is a separate entry.
usage.zh: 用来写独自彷徨、怅惘沉思。是《浣溪沙》（一曲新词酒一杯）的结句，其前是名联“无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来”，已另收词条。

synonyms: 无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来

text: 欲寄彩笺兼尺素，山长水阔知何处
pinyin: yù jì cǎi jiān jiān chǐ sù, shān cháng shuǐ kuò zhī hé chù
literal: wish · send · coloured · note-paper · and · letter, mountains · long · waters · wide · know · where · place
natural: I want to send coloured notes and a letter, but with mountains so long and waters so wide, where is the one I long for?

meaning.en: I want to write to my beloved, but with endless mountains and rivers in between I do not even know where to send it.
meaning.zh: 想给远方的人写信寄去，可山遥水远，不知道该寄往何处。

equivalents: a letter with nowhere to go

examples.zh: 远在他乡，她写好了信却不知寄往何处，只得叹“欲寄彩笺兼尺素，山长水阔知何处”。
examples.en: Far away, she had written the letter but had nowhere to send it and sighed, 'I want to send a letter, but with mountains long and waters wide, where?'

examples.zh: 读到“欲寄彩笺兼尺素，山长水阔知何处”，同学们想起了失联的老朋友。
examples.en: Reading 'I want to send notes and a letter, but mountains are long and waters wide', the students thought of old friends who had lost touch.

story.en: From Yan Shu's 《蝶恋花》 beginning 槛菊愁烟兰泣露, which follows the line 昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路 before this couplet about a letter with nowhere to go.
story.zh: 出自晏殊《蝶恋花》（槛菊愁烟兰泣露）；上文有“昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路”，此联接着写无处可寄的书信。

date.en: Northern Song, first half of 11th c.

usage.en: Quoted for longing for a distant loved one with no way to reach them. 尺素 means a letter, from old letters written on a foot of silk.
usage.zh: 用来写思念远人而音信难通。“尺素”指书信，古人以一尺长的白绢写信。

text: 无情不似多情苦，一寸还成千万缕
pinyin: wú qíng bù sì duō qíng kǔ, yī cùn huán chéng qiān wàn lǚ
literal: without · feeling · not · like · much · feeling · bitter, one · inch · still · becomes · thousand · ten thousand · threads
natural: the unfeeling are spared the pain of the feeling; every inch of heart splits into a thousand threads

meaning.en: People without feelings are not troubled like those with deep feelings, whose every inch of heart is torn into countless threads of sorrow.
meaning.zh: 无情的人不会像多情的人那样痛苦，多情之人的心，每一寸都化作千丝万缕的愁。

equivalents: the price of a tender heart

examples.zh: 看完这部电影，他忽然懂了“无情不似多情苦，一寸还成千万缕”。
examples.en: After the film he suddenly understood 'the unfeeling are spared the pain of the tender, whose every inch of heart is cut into a thousand threads'.

examples.zh: 她在日记里抄下“无情不似多情苦，一寸还成千万缕”。
examples.en: In her diary she copied 'the unfeeling are spared the pain of the feeling, whose every inch of heart splits into a thousand threads'.

story.en: The last couplet of Yan Shu's 《玉楼春》 on spring sorrow, following lines that say that even earth and sky have ends, but longing has none.
story.zh: 晏殊《玉楼春》（春恨）的结联，前文说天涯地角总有尽头，唯有相思没有尽头。

date.en: Northern Song, first half of 11th c.

usage.en: Quoted for the pain that comes with deep feeling. It closes 《玉楼春》 (春恨), after 天涯地角有穷时，只有相思无尽处.
usage.zh: 用来写重情之人反而更苦。是《玉楼春》（春恨）的结句，前文有“天涯地角有穷时，只有相思无尽处”。

text: 今宵剩把银釭照，犹恐相逢是梦中
pinyin: jīn xiāo shèng bǎ yín gāng zhào, yóu kǒng xiāng féng shì mèng zhōng
literal: tonight · keep · take · silver · lamp · shine, still · fear · meet · is · dream · within
natural: tonight I hold the silver lamp up to look at you, still afraid that this meeting is only a dream

meaning.en: After a long parting, the lovers meet again, and by lamplight keep gazing at each other for fear that the reunion is just a dream.
meaning.zh: 久别重逢，两人举灯细看，仍怕这重逢不过是一场梦。

equivalents: a reunion too good to be true

examples.zh: 机场出口，她紧紧抱住他，仿佛“今宵剩把银釭照，犹恐相逢是梦中”。
examples.en: At the airport exit she held him tight, as if 'tonight I hold up the lamp, still afraid our meeting is a dream'.

examples.zh: 战友多年后重逢，真是“今宵剩把银釭照，犹恐相逢是梦中”。
examples.en: When the comrades met again after many years, it was truly 'tonight I hold up the lamp, still fearing this meeting is a dream'.

story.en: Yan Jidao (1038-1110), son of Yan Shu, wrote this ci on meeting a lost love again: the dance and song they once shared, years of dreaming of each other, and then this couplet at the reunion.
story.zh: 晏几道（1038—1110）是晏殊之子，这首词写与旧日情人重逢：先忆当年歌舞，再叙多年梦中相见，最后以此联写相逢。

usage.en: Quoted for a reunion so joyful it seems unreal. 银釭 means a silver-coloured lamp. Du Fu's 夜阑更秉烛，相对如梦寐 has the same feeling.
usage.zh: 用来写久别重逢、喜出望外而难以置信。“银釭”指银色的灯。杜甫“夜阑更秉烛，相对如梦寐”与此意境相近。

text: 梦里不知身是客，一晌贪欢
pinyin: mèng lǐ bù zhī shēn shì kè, yī shǎng tān huān
literal: dream · inside · not · know · body · is · guest, one · moment · greedy · joy
natural: in the dream I forgot I was a captive, and for a moment I revelled in joy

meaning.en: In a dream the poet forgot that he was a prisoner far from home, and for a short while enjoyed his old happiness before waking to reality.
meaning.zh: 梦中忘了自己是羁旅他乡的囚徒，暂时贪恋片刻的欢乐，醒来却一场空。

equivalents: a fleeting dream of better days

examples.zh: 他梦见回到故乡，醒来后只能叹“梦里不知身是客，一晌贪欢”。
examples.en: He dreamed of home, and on waking could only sigh, 'in the dream I forgot I was a stranger, and for a moment I revelled in joy'.

examples.zh: 作文里她引用“梦里不知身是客，一晌贪欢”，表达思乡之情。
examples.en: In her essay she quoted 'in the dream I forgot I was a guest, and for a moment I revelled in joy' to express homesickness.

story.en: Li Yu (937-978), the last ruler of the Southern Tang, wrote this ci as a captive of the Song; the lines come after 罗衾不耐五更寒 and before the famous 独自莫凭栏，无限江山.
story.zh: 李煜（937—978）是南唐后主，亡国后被囚于宋，写下这首词；此句承“罗衾不耐五更寒”，下接“独自莫凭栏，无限江山”。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang · Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: Quoted for dreams of home and the pain of waking. 客 here means one living away from home. 一晌 means a short while.
usage.zh: 用来写梦回故乡与醒后的失落。这里的“客”指羁旅异乡之人，“一晌”指片刻。

text: 最是仓皇辞庙日，教坊犹奏别离歌，垂泪对宫娥
pinyin: zuì shì cāng huáng cí miào rì, jiào fāng yóu zòu bié lí gē, chuí lèi duì gōng é
literal: most · is · hurried · leave · temple · day, music bureau · still · plays · parting · song, shedding · tears · facing · palace · maids
natural: the hardest was the hurried day of leaving the ancestral temple, the court band still playing a farewell song, and I wept before the palace maids

meaning.en: The poet remembers the day he fled and left the royal ancestral temple in panic, while the court musicians played a farewell song and he wept facing the palace women.
meaning.zh: 回想国亡时仓皇辞别宗庙的那天，宫中乐队还奏着离别的曲子，自己只能对着宫女垂泪。

examples.zh: 参观南京博物院时，他想起了“最是仓皇辞庙日，教坊犹奏别离歌，垂泪对宫娥”。
examples.en: Visiting the museum he thought of 'the hardest was the hurried day of leaving the temple, the court band still playing a farewell song, and weeping before the maids'.

examples.zh: 史书写国破之痛，不及这句“最是仓皇辞庙日，教坊犹奏别离歌，垂泪对宫娥”动人。
examples.en: Histories of a fallen state are less moving than this line 'the hurried day of leaving the temple, the band playing farewell, weeping before the palace maids'.

story.en: Li Yu recalls the day Southern Tang surrendered to the Song in 975, when he left his capital; the ci begins 四十年来家国 and tells of forty years of rule ending in this humiliating scene.
story.zh: 李煜追忆975年南唐降宋、离开金陵的那一天；这首词以“四十年来家国”开篇，写四十年基业以这屈辱的场面收束。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang · Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: Quoted for the sorrow of a fallen dynasty or of leaving home in a rout. 教坊 was the imperial music bureau.  Some editions read 挥泪 for 垂泪.
usage.zh: 用来写国破家亡的悲痛或仓皇离乡。“教坊”是宫廷音乐机构。个别版本作“挥泪对宫娥”。

text: 待从头、收拾旧山河，朝天阙
pinyin: dài cóng tóu, shōu shí jiù shān hé, cháo tiān què
literal: wait · from · the start, gather up · old · mountains · rivers, face · heaven's · palace gate
natural: then I shall start again, restore the old land, and go to court to report

meaning.en: The poet vows to retake the lost northern lands from the beginning and then return in triumph to report to the emperor.
meaning.zh: 立誓重新收复沦陷的旧日河山，然后凯旋回朝，向天子复命。

examples.zh: 国庆演讲中，他引用“待从头、收拾旧山河，朝天阙”表达报国之志。
examples.en: In his National Day speech he quoted 'I shall start again, restore the old land, and go to court to report' to express his wish to serve his country.

examples.zh: 这首词最后一句“待从头、收拾旧山河，朝天阙”，读来令人热血沸腾。
examples.en: The last line of the ci, 'I shall start again, restore the old land, and go to court to report', stirs the blood.

story.en: By tradition this ci is by the Southern Song general Yue Fei (1103-1142), whose ‘Man Jiang Hong’ is a symbol of patriotism; some modern scholars doubt that he wrote it, because the earliest known text dates from the Ming. The line is its ending.
story.zh: 传统上，此词为南宋名将岳飞（1103—1142）所作，是爱国精神的象征；但现代有学者怀疑，因为最早的文本见于明代。这是它的结句。

usage.en: Quoted for patriotic resolve to recover lost territory. 天阙 means the imperial palace gate. The attribution to Yue Fei is traditional; some scholars doubt it, as the text is first recorded only in the Ming dynasty.
usage.zh: 用来表达收复河山的爱国壮志。“天阙”指皇宫宫门。作者传统上归于岳飞，但有学者质疑，因此词到明代才见记载。

text: 毕竟西湖六月中，风光不与四时同
pinyin: bì jìng xī hú liù yuè zhōng, fēng guāng bù yǔ sì shí tóng
literal: after all · West Lake · sixth · month · in, scenery · not · with · four · seasons · same
natural: after all, West Lake in the sixth month has scenery unlike any other season

meaning.en: In midsummer West Lake has a beauty all its own, quite different from the other seasons.
meaning.zh: 西湖六月的景色格外壮美，和其他季节都不一样。

examples.zh: 六月游西湖，真是“毕竟西湖六月中，风光不与四时同”。
examples.en: Visiting West Lake in June, it was truly 'after all, in the sixth month West Lake's scenery differs from all the other seasons'.

examples.zh: 旅行社的海报写着“毕竟西湖六月中，风光不与四时同”。
examples.en: The travel agency's poster read 'after all, West Lake in June has scenery unlike any other season'.

origin.source: 杨万里《晓出净慈寺送林子方》

story.en: Yang Wanli (1127-1206) wrote this quatrain as he saw his friend Lin Zifang off at dawn from Jingci Temple on West Lake; the other two lines describe the endless green lotus leaves and the lotus flowers red in the sun.
story.zh: 杨万里（1127—1206）清晨在西湖净慈寺送别友人林子方时作此绝句；后两句写莲叶无穷碧、荷花映日红。

usage.en: Quoted to praise West Lake in summer, or any place at its seasonal best. It is often quoted together with the next couplet, 接天莲叶无穷碧，映日荷花别样红.
usage.zh: 用来赞美夏日西湖，也泛指某地某季的独特美景。常与下联“接天莲叶无穷碧，映日荷花别样红”连用。

text: 正入万山圈子里，一山放出一山拦
pinyin: zhèng rù wàn shān quān zi lǐ, yī shān fàng chū yī shān lán
literal: just · enter · ten thousand · mountains · circle · inside, one · mountain · lets out · one · mountain · blocks
natural: just as I enter a ring of countless mountains, one lets me out and the next blocks my way

meaning.en: Just as you escape one mountain, another blocks your way; a lively image of obstacles that keep coming.
meaning.zh: 刚走出一座山，又被另一座山拦住去路；形象地说困难接连不断。

equivalents: out of the frying pan into the fire

examples.zh: 创业路上，他总是“正入万山圈子里，一山放出一山拦”。
examples.en: On the road of starting a business, it was always 'no sooner in the ring of mountains than one lets him out and the next blocks the way'.

examples.zh: 事情一件接一件，真是“正入万山圈子里，一山放出一山拦”。
examples.en: One thing after another, truly 'no sooner out of one mountain than the next blocks the way'.

origin.source: 杨万里《过松源晨炊漆公店》

story.en: Yang Wanli wrote a set of five quatrains while travelling past Songyuan; this one, the fifth, ends with the traveller's delight at the mountains that seem to play games with him. The poem opens with a warning not to say that going downhill is easy.
story.zh: 杨万里途经松源时作组诗五首，此为第五首，写行人感到群山像在与自己嬉戏。首句警告说别以为下山容易。

usage.en: Quoted for difficulties that arrive one after another. Yang Wanli's own twist is that the mountains seem to play a game with the traveller, so the tone is wry rather than grim.
usage.zh: 用来形容困难接连不断。杨万里把群山写得像在与行人嬉戏，语气诙谐而不沉重。

text: 有约不来过夜半，闲敲棋子落灯花
pinyin: yǒu yuē bù lái guò yè bàn, xián qiāo qí zǐ luò dēng huā
literal: have · appointment · not · come · past · midnight, idly · tap · chess pieces · drop · lamp · flower
natural: he made an appointment but has not come, and past midnight I idly tap the chess pieces until the lamp-wick flowers fall

meaning.en: A friend has not come by midnight; the poet waits calmly, tapping a chess piece on the board so that ash falls from the lamp.
meaning.zh: 约好的朋友过了半夜还没来，诗人闲敲棋子，震落了灯花，写出等待的从容与寂寥。

examples.zh: 朋友迟迟未到，他在窗前自嘲“有约不来过夜半，闲敲棋子落灯花”。
examples.en: His friend was late, and he joked at the window, 'a promised guest has not come by midnight, I idly tap the chess pieces until the wick flowers fall'.

examples.zh: 夜深了，她还在等他，真像“有约不来过夜半，闲敲棋子落灯花”。
examples.en: Deep in the night she was still waiting for him, just like 'the guest has not come by midnight, idly tapping chess pieces'.

story.en: Zhao Shixiu (1170-1219), one of the 'Four Lings of Yongjia', wrote this quatrain on a rainy early-summer night: plum rain, frogs croaking, a guest who has not come, and chess played alone.
story.zh: 赵师秀（1170—1219）为“永嘉四灵”之一，此绝句写梅雨时节的夜晚：雨声、蛙鸣、未至的客人，与独自对弈。

usage.en: Quoted for waiting for someone who is late, with a hint of wry calm. 灯花 is the glowing wick of an oil lamp, often read as an omen.
usage.zh: 用来写等候迟到的人，带几分从容和无奈。“灯花”指油灯芯燃烧结成的花，古人以为吉兆。

text: 何处合成愁，离人心上秋
pinyin: hé chù hé chéng chóu, lí rén xīn shàng qiū
literal: where · put together · becomes · sorrow, parting · person · heart · above · autumn
natural: where does sorrow come from? autumn on the heart of one who parts

meaning.en: A pun on the written form of 愁: put 秋 (autumn) on top of 心 (heart) and you get sorrow, the sorrow of a traveller in autumn.
meaning.zh: 拆字联想：“秋”字加“心”字便是“愁”，离别的人心上有秋，便是愁。

examples.zh: 他在贺卡上写下“何处合成愁，离人心上秋”，送给远行的朋友。
examples.en: On the card he wrote 'where does sorrow come from? autumn on the heart of one who parts' and gave it to a friend setting out.

examples.zh: 老师讲词时，用“何处合成愁，离人心上秋”说明拆字的修辞。
examples.en: When teaching ci, the teacher used 'where does sorrow come from? autumn on the heart of one who parts' to explain wordplay on characters.

story.en: Wu Wenying (c.1200-c.1260) opens this ci with the question and answer that splits the character 愁 in two; it goes on to tell of a parting in the autumn rain.
story.zh: 吴文英（约1200—约1260）的这首词以设问开篇，将“愁”字拆为“秋”与“心”，随后写秋雨中的离别。

usage.en: Quoted for autumn parting and as a classic example of character-splitting wordplay: 秋 over 心 makes 愁.
usage.zh: 用来写秋日别愁，也是拆字修辞的经典例子：“秋”在“心”上，合成“愁”。

text: 此水几时休，此恨何时已
pinyin: cǐ shuǐ jǐ shí xiū, cǐ hèn hé shí yǐ
literal: this · water · when · stop, this · regret · when · end
natural: when will this river stop flowing, and when will this longing end?

meaning.en: The river goes on endlessly, so does the longing: when will either stop?
meaning.zh: 江水奔流不息，相思之恨也无尽头：两者何时才能停歇？

equivalents: a longing as endless as the river

examples.zh: 读到“此水几时休，此恨何时已”，她想起远方的他。
examples.en: Reading 'when will this river stop, when will this longing end?', she thought of him far away.

examples.zh: 长江边的碑上刻着“此水几时休，此恨何时已”。
examples.en: The stele on the Yangtze bank is carved 'when will this river stop, when will this longing end?'.

story.en: Li Zhiyi (c.1048-after 1117) wrote this ci, beginning 我住长江头，君住长江尾; the lovers live at opposite ends of the same river and share its water.
story.zh: 李之仪（约1048—1117年后）此词以“我住长江头，君住长江尾”开篇，两人各居长江两端，共饮一江水。

usage.en: Quoted for endless longing, as the river never ceases. It follows 日日思君不见君，共饮长江水 and is followed by 只愿君心似我心，定不负相思意.
usage.zh: 用来写如江水般无尽的相思。上接“日日思君不见君，共饮长江水”，下接“只愿君心似我心，定不负相思意”。

text: 梧桐半死清霜后，头白鸳鸯失伴飞
pinyin: wú tóng bàn sǐ qīng shuāng hòu, tóu bái yuān yāng shī bàn fēi
literal: plane tree · half · dead · clear · frost · after, head · white · mandarin duck · lose · mate · fly
natural: the plane tree half dead after the frost, a white-headed mandarin duck flies on, having lost its mate

meaning.en: A widower's lament for his dead wife: he is like a plane tree half withered by frost, or an old mandarin duck flying on alone.
meaning.zh: 丧妻者的悲叹：自己如被霜打得半枯的梧桐，又似白头失伴、独自飞行的鸳鸯。

examples.zh: 悼亡之作里，这句“梧桐半死清霜后，头白鸳鸯失伴飞”最为凄凉。
examples.en: Of the elegies for a dead spouse, 'the plane tree half dead after the frost, a white-headed mandarin duck flying on without its mate' is the bleakest.

examples.zh: 老伴去世后，他常念着“梧桐半死清霜后，头白鸳鸯失伴飞”。
examples.en: After his wife died he often recited 'the plane tree half dead after the frost, the white-headed mandarin duck flying without its mate'.

story.en: He Zhu (1052-1125) wrote this ci, beginning 重过阊门万事非, on passing through Suzhou's Changmen Gate again after the death of his wife; it is a famous elegy for a dead spouse.
story.zh: 贺铸（1052—1125）妻子去世后重过苏州阊门，作此词（以“重过阊门万事非”开篇），是著名的悼亡词。

usage.en: Quoted for grief at the death of a spouse in old age. 半死桐 later became a literary byword for a widower. Use with care, as it is a very sad line.
usage.zh: 用来写老年丧偶之痛。“半死桐”后来成为丧妻的文学代称。语气极悲，使用须慎重。

text: 水是眼波横，山是眉峰聚
pinyin: shuǐ shì yǎn bō héng, shān shì méi fēng jù
literal: water · is · eye · ripple · flowing sideways, mountains · are · brows · peaks · gathered
natural: the water is the flowing ripple of her eyes, the mountains the gathered peaks of her brows

meaning.en: A playful image: the water is like a beauty's glancing eyes and the hills like her knitted brows.
meaning.zh: 比喻新巧：水像美人流动的眼波，山像她聚拢的眉峰。

examples.zh: 看着江南的山水，他笑道：“水是眼波横，山是眉峰聚。”
examples.en: Looking at the hills and waters of Jiangnan, he smiled, 'the water is the sidelong ripple of her eyes, the hills the gathered peaks of her brows'.

examples.zh: 导游用“水是眼波横，山是眉峰聚”来形容桂林山水。
examples.en: The guide used 'the water is her sidelong eyes, the hills her gathered brows' to describe the scenery of Guilin.

origin.source: 王观《卜算子·送鲍浩然之浙东》

story.en: Wang Guan (1035-1100) wrote this ci to see off his friend Bao Haoran, who was going to eastern Zhejiang; it turns the farewell into a cheerful wish for spring along his way.
story.zh: 王观（1035—1100）为送友人鲍浩然赴浙东而作，把离别写得乐观，祝愿友人赶上江南春光。

usage.en: Quoted for lovely scenery, with the playful picture of landscape as a beautiful woman. It is the opening of the ci, followed by 欲问行人去那边，眉眼盈盈处.
usage.zh: 用来赞美山水之美，把山水比作美人，俏皮新巧。是该词开篇，下接“欲问行人去那边，眉眼盈盈处”。
